on the web.copy: See links to useful websites and videos that can help you to take your learning further.

quick quiz.copy: Quick quizzes are a great way to test your knowledge.

summary.copy: Read key summaries of content covered so far in the course materials.

stretch.copy: These optional activities help you to expand your knowledge and explore the subject further.

key point.copy: Use these to reflect on how you will answer the assessment questions.

time to think.copy: Note your ideas in the box provided. Use them to help answer assessment questions.  (You can save your Time to think text to your journal).

read more about it.copy: Learn about a topic in even greater detail.

watch.copy: Watch a video to learn more about a topic.

case study.copy: Read, listen to, or interact with case studies throughout the course to explore examples in context.

time to practice.copy: Practice your new skills in your own programs. Use these practice sessions to help you to create content for your assessments.

sentences.sentence: Statutory employment rights address the legal rights of every employee in the country
Many small businesses provide their employees with access to a stakeholder pension scheme
The Equality Act 2010 protects women from being paid less than men for doing the same job
The Working Time Regulations provide employees with the right to paid annual leave
The Data Protection Act 1998 restricts the use of personal data an organisation can hold about someone
